objectives.statement: Recognize and place common sentence adverbs after the finite verb in main clauses.
Recognize and place common sentence adverbs before the finite verb in subordinate clauses.
Use sentence adverbs with compound tenses and notice light word placement around ikke.

notes: Must contrast main-clause placement after finite verb with subordinate-clause placement before finite verb; include compound tenses. Include the light/heavy subject and object pattern around ikke, for example pronouns before ikke but heavy noun phrases often after ikke after fronting.
